2608.18260.title: Redakto - The Incognito Tab for LLMs
2608.18260.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being increasingly used in everyday applications. A major challenge in the context of LLMs or Artificial Intelligence (AI) in general is to ensure privacy when using them, meaning that personally identifiable information (PII) is removed from any text that enters an LLM. These challenges have become more urgent with novel EU legislation. Uncertainty around LLM usage with respect to privacy concerns in EU countries can be a major blocker for the speed of innovation and transfer from research to applications. Here we present \textbf{Redakto}, a tool that can be used for anonymizing text prior to feeding it to an LLM or other downstream text processing. We provide state-of-the-art functionalities for both redaction of PII but also when used for pseudonymization. These functionalities are exposed such that they can easily be used by end-users, through the Redakto web application, and by developers and researchers, via REST APIs and model context protocol (MCP) hooks. The implementation is fully open source, requires modest compute resources, and can be readily deployed on local hardware. In contrast to prior work and in order to better assess the quality of the anonymized texts, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations on textual data from legal and medical domain with respect to both privacy and utility of the redacted texts. Our empirical results demonstrate that the texts anonymized with different redaction strategies achieve utility scores on par with the original texts, suggesting that anonymization with Redakto can be used for LLM tasks without substantial negative impact for the tasks we explored.
2608.18260.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在日常應用中越來越受到使用。<lb/>在LLMs或人工智慧（AI）的一般背景下，一個主要挑戰是確保使用時的隱私，這意味著任何進入LLM的文本中都必須去除個人可識別信息（PII）。<lb/>隨著歐盟新立法的出台，這些挑戰變得更加迫切。<lb/>在歐盟國家中，關於隱私問題的LLM使用不確定性可能成為創新速度和從研究轉向應用的主要障礙。<lb/>在此，我們介紹\textbf{Redakto}，這是一個可以在將文本輸入LLM或其他下游文本處理之前用於匿名化的工具。<lb/>我們提供最先進的功能，既可以用於去除PII，也可以用於假名化。<lb/>這些功能的設計使得最終用戶可以輕鬆使用，通過Redakto網頁應用程序，以及開發者和研究人員可以通過REST API和模型上下文協議（MCP）鉤子使用。<lb/>該實現完全開源，需要適度的計算資源，並且可以輕鬆部署在本地硬體上。<lb/>與之前的工作相比，為了更好地評估匿名文本的質量，我們對法律和醫療領域的文本數據進行了廣泛的實證評估，考慮到去除文本的隱私性和效用。<lb/>我們的實證結果顯示，使用不同去除策略匿名化的文本在效用分數上與原始文本相當，這表明使用Redakto進行匿名化可以在我們探索的任務中用於LLM任務，而不會對這些任務造成實質性的負面影響。
